Chapter 360: Chapter 15 The ‘Uncrowned King’ of Tianqing World (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

“The power of space, the power of space can also be used like this?”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s spirit shuddered, for at his level, he had naturally begun to comprehend Space Rules long ago.

However, the foundations of the Tianqing World were limited, and the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s comprehension of the Space Rules had always been like a blind man feeling an elephant.

For the Tianqing Alliance Leader, his comprehension of Space Rules had no so-called foundation, no core space model to reference.

He could only rely on himself.

...

Here’s a simple example.

The dimensional assault brought by Lin Yuan from the exceedingly prosperous Main World of the Human Civilization Alliance upon the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

“Hmm?”

Ignoring the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s shock, Lin Yuan shifted his gaze toward a certain direction.

That was the direction where the Evil God Battlefield once existed, but now, a vast aura was rapidly approaching.

“Is it the World Sword?”

Lin Yuan had anticipated this.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader, having wielded the World Sword for four hundred years, definitely had an extraordinary connection to it.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader facing mortal peril meant the World Sword moving on its own to protect its master was only normal, and still within Lin Yuan’s expectations.

“Just… it’s too late…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If the Tianqing Alliance Leader had summoned the World Sword back before entering the Black Mist Mountain Range, he might have had the ability to contend with Lin Yuan.

But now?

Even the World Sword, flying from outside the Tianqing World to the Black Mist Mountain Range, would take at least a good half of an incense stick’s time.

In such a long time, the Tianqing Alliance Leader would have already been crushed and rounded by Lin Yuan.

Of course.

Lin Yuan also considered that the World Sword could traverse space, akin to teleportation, to get closer to the Black Mist Mountain Range.

But Lin Yuan had prepared countermeasures.

The World Sword was indeed powerful, but it also needed its master to activate it.

Without an active World Sword, its power greatly diminished, otherwise there would be no need for the Tianqing Alliance Leader to wield it.

Why not just let it fight the Ancestral Demon Tree directly?

And with its power greatly diminished, Lin Yuan was confident he could delay the World Sword.

“Start the parasitic control…”

With just a thought from Lin Yuan, a dull gray seed began to fall, entering the Spatial Prison.

And in the few breaths since, under Lin Yuan’s casual attack, the Tianqing Alliance Leader trapped in the Spatial Prison was already severely wounded and dying.

If Lin Yuan didn’t have the idea of parasitic control, the Tianqing Alliance Leader would have died long ago.

“Ahhhhhhh… is this parasitic control? No, the parasitic methods of the Foreign Evil God shouldn’t be like this…”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader moaned in pain.

At this moment, countless images flashed through his mind—his own subordinates, elders, and loved ones, inexplicably betraying him…

“So that’s how it is…”

A look of realization appeared on the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s face.

So, they didn’t betray him, but were controlled by this spawn of the Evil God?

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s gaze showed relief, and in the next instant,

The Tianqing Alliance Leader closed his eyes and bowed to Lin Yuan, saying, “I’ve seen the master.”

Parasitic control was successful.

For four hundred years, the Tianqing Alliance Leader had fought with the Ancestral Demon Tree, possessing the strength of the Eighth Layer.

But most of that relied on the World Sword, and as for the Tianqing Alliance Leader himself, he was still at the Seventh Rank.

Therefore.

Facing Lin Yuan, who had also reached the Seventh-Rank Peak and whose combat power was not much weaker than the Ancestral Demon Tree, the Tianqing Alliance Leader naturally had no power to resist.

…

“Master.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader spoke respectfully.

“Rise.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

To deal with this Tianqing Alliance Leader, Lin Yuan had made many arrangements and backup plans.

For instance, he anticipated the possibility of the Tianqing Alliance Leader breaking out of the Spatial Prison.

Even if the Tianqing Alliance Leader really did manage this, there were still more measures waiting for him afterward.

“Can you still control the World Sword?”

Lin Yuan asked directly.

Communicating with his own parasite, a direct inquiry was enough.

“Master…”

“I should be able to…”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader closed his eyes to sense for a while before nodding in reply.

“Very good.”

A smile appeared in Lin Yuan’s mind.

The reason he went to such lengths, trying to control the Tianqing Alliance Leader,

Was not only because of the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s strength as the strongest in the Tianqing World.

“`

What is more important is the World Sword.

The World Sword was born from the Tianqing World.

In theory, it had no possibility of emerging, as it was closely related to the Origin Source of the Tianqing World.

If Lin Yuan could obtain the World Sword and, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, ponder over it, he might decipher the grand secret of the world’s rotation and life and death, and then integrate it into his Inner World.

Eighth Layer Evolvers and even Ninth Rank Evolvers’ cultivations were primarily focused on the Inner World.

Constantly perfecting the Inner World, enabling it to grow, and eventually become a true big world.

“Go, bring back the World Sword.”

Lin Yuan ordered the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

“Yes.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader got up and left.

After half an hour.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader returned.

But this time, he held a stone-made long sword in his hand.

This long sword, made entirely of gray-white stone, yet vaguely emitted the fluctuations of a power that commanded the world.

“Is this the World Sword?”

With a thought from Lin Yuan, the World Sword in the hands of the Tianqing Alliance Leader flew towards Lin Yuan.

Humm!!

Perhaps it sensed something.

The World Sword began to struggle violently.

“If we were outside, you might have a chance to break free.”

“But here…”

Lin Yuan chuckled coldly.

Having operated the Black Mist Mountain Range for a hundred years or so, every inch of space was within his grasp, leaving the World Sword no possibility to resist.

Soon.

Lin Yuan’s mind and consciousness briefly touched the World Sword.

“Hmm?”

Through the World Sword, Lin Yuan faintly sensed the massive Origin Source of the Tianqing World, and the world consciousness that had fallen into slumber.

“As expected…”

It didn’t surprise Lin Yuan at all that the world consciousness had fallen into slumber; it was to be expected.

Did one truly believe using the World Sword came without any price?

If that was the case, then why wouldn’t the Tianqing World let the World Sword emerge?

If it weren’t for the invasion of the Ancestral Demon Tree, which posed a destructive threat to the Tianqing World, it is likely that the World Sword wouldn’t have emerged this time either.

“The World Sword is the manifest core essence of the Tianqing World. Every time the World Sword is used, it shakes the consciousness of the Tianqing World.”

“Over time, after numerous uses, the world consciousness of the Tianqing World will fall into slumber.”

“Of course, even if the world consciousness falls asleep, the Tianqing World still has an almost instinctive defense against the outside world, but for the inside of the world…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If the world consciousness of the Tianqing World were awake, Lin Yuan’s growth would definitely not have been so smooth.

This was also thanks to the Ancestral Demon Tree; without this Foreign Evil God, the Tianqing Alliance Leader would not have frequently urged the World Sword and eventually reached a certain limit that put the world consciousness to sleep completely.

…

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking down at the Tianqing Alliance Leader, the Vice Alliance Hierarch, protectors, elders, the Four Divine Beast Kings, and the Demon Beast Kings.

If one said that before gaining control over the Tianqing Alliance Leader, Lin Yuan was merely the hidden puppeteer of the Tianqing World.

Now, Lin Yuan was the true ‘uncrowned king’ of the Tianqing World.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, more than half a year had gone by.

During this time, Lin Yuan had the Tianqing Alliance Leader and others return to the Tianqing Mountain, the central point of the Tianqing World, to receive the worship of all beings, as per the regular plan.

Moreover, under Lin Yuan’s secret push, the Martial Tao Cultivation System had officially become the most authoritative cultivation system in the Tianqing World, standing side by side with the original cultivation system.

With Lin Yuan’s influence, it was foreseeable that in a few hundred years, the cultivation system of the Tianqing World would be completely replaced by Martial Tao.

In the deepest part of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness converged in the root area.

Staring at the clump of dark flames burning.

“It’s almost time.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

It was also time to deal with the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Lin Yuan worried that if he continued to wait, the Ancestral Demon Tree might think of forcibly ‘cutting itself loose’ and fleeing.

With this thought, Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and began to contact the Ancestral Demon Tree through the dark flame.

The dark flame was the hinge between the Ancestral Demon Tree and Lin Yuan; the Ancestral Demon Tree could contact Lin Yuan through this flame.

Lin Yuan could also do the opposite.

Of course, originally, a tree demon spawn like Lin Yuan did not have the right to actively contact the Ancestral Demon Tree.

But, after the last release of his talents, the Ancestral Demon Tree simply allowed Lin Yuan to contact it at any time.

There was no other way.

As of now, Lin Yuan was its only surviving offspring, its hope to recover all losses by descending upon the Tianqing World.
